wiktionary.format: Kaikki postprocessed per-language JSONL; deprecated upstream, not raw Wiktextract data
wiktionary.modifications: Retain 3–11-tile Russian headwords, excluding proper-name POS, with Zipf >=2.5, parts of speech, glosses, sense tags and form/alternative relationships only. Omit enrichment categories, disambiguation, audio, examples, quotations, translations, etymology and non-Russian scripts/spellings. Preserve original headwords and per-record input hashes. NFC and uppercase preserve Й and Ё as distinct letters from И and Е. No transliteration or accent stripping. Only А–Я and Ё are playable. Exact source spelling and case are retained. No exact article revision is supplied by this snapshot.

wordfreq.author: Robyn Speer and contributors
wordfreq.modifications: Retain 3–11-letter spelling frequency bins matching lexical evidence. For lexical Ё words use the maximum exact spelling and its Е spelling frequency, reflecting optional dots in ordinary Russian writing. This is a frequency-only estimate, never a lexical/gameplay alias, and can overestimate a specific sense. Й and И never fold. Editorial review is separate. For case-normalized homographs use the maximum supplied estimate, not a sum. Historical mixed-corpus spelling frequencies do not certify individual senses or contemporary regional usage.
